title: Bodyweight Repeaters - B
texts: Deadhangs - 7 on 3 off for 30 seconds at bodyweight only

This session is designed to prepare the fingers for higher intensity work for beginner to intermediate climbers. You will need to use the interval timer to monitor your hangs.

Repeat for 5 sets in total for a full session.

Aim to complete straight armed with shoulders engaged, but if you suffer shoulder discomfort in this position then aim for 90-150 degree angle at the elbow.

This is only to be completed at body weight using a half crimp grip position.
